name: @red-cup-engineering/node-runtime-release-promotion-service
description: Atomically bind one verified content-addressed Node runtime release to a named deployment pointer.

scripts.verify: node --check src/promote-release.mjs && node --check bin/promote-node-runtime-release.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs

promote-node-runtime-release.accepts: one verified content-addressed runtime release identity and one named deployment pointer
promote-node-runtime-release.returns: one atomic promotion receipt retaining the prior release identity
